candidates.exact_span: If there is no discharge from any outfall during the sampling month, place an "X" in the NO DISCHARGE box located in the upper right corner of the Discharge Monitoring Report.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of 'no discharge from any outfall' (per-outfall vs all-outfalls), what counts as the 'sampling month', and whether marking the NO DISCHARGE box satisfies the reporting obligation could change whether monitoring/reporting was required for a given period (B) and whether a no-result period is classified as a documented no-discharge state versus missing or unresolved evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: If any daily maximum or monthly average value exceeds the effluent limitations specified in Part I. A, the permittee shall report the excursion in accordance with the requirements of Part III. D.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a reported value is compared as a daily maximum or monthly average, and which Part I.A effluent limitation applies to that statistic, could change exceedance determinations (A). The trigger 'exceeds the effluent limitations' also defines when excursion reporting is required, affecting whether a monitoring/reporting obligation was applicable (B).

candidates.exact_span: Any daily maximum or monthly average value reported in the required Discharge Monitoring Report which is in excess of the effluent limitation specified in Part I. A shall constitute evidence of violation of such effluent limitation and of this permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Different readings of 'daily maximum or monthly average', 'in excess of the effluent limitation', and which Part I.A limit governs each reported statistic could change whether a measurement is treated as exceeding the applicable enforceable numeric limit (A).
